summary: Current project host-visible surfaces for ZOTERO-HOST-WAVE-001. Surface smoke is authoritative for visible host integrations before whole-window screenshots are treated as proof.

surfaces.summary: Open the cleanroom preference pane from Zotero preferences and verify that the pane root plus core controls render.
smokeChecks: Host Action `preferences.openPane` opens the preferences window and selects the requested pane.
The target preference pane root is visible and at least one core control is ready.
A surface-local evidence target is returned for the selected preference pane.

surfaces.summary: Switch a library Item Pane sidenav button and verify that the selected pane becomes visible and ready.
smokeChecks: Host Action `itemPane.selectPane` scrolls or switches to the requested pane.
The target pane is visible in the Item Pane container after selection.
A surface-local evidence target is returned for the selected Item Pane surface.

surfaces.summary: Open the right context pane and switch to the requested context pane section for the active reader tab.
smokeChecks: Host Action `contextPane.setOpen` opens the right context pane.
Host Action `contextPane.selectPane` makes the requested pane visible in the active context pane container.
A surface-local evidence target is returned for the selected context pane surface.

surfaces.summary: Verify that the Reader renderToolbar injection becomes visible in a live reader instance and exposes a local evidence target.
smokeChecks: A live reader instance is opened through Host Action `reader.open`.
The renderToolbar integration becomes visible in the reader toolbar.
A surface-local evidence target is returned for the toolbar surface.

surfaces.summary: Switch the active Reader sidebar view and verify that the requested sidebar surface is selected and ready.
smokeChecks: Host Action `reader.sidebar.selectView` selects the requested reader sidebar view.
The selected sidebar view is observed in the live reader state or DOM.
A surface-local evidence target is returned for the active reader sidebar view.

surfaces.summary: Show a live Zotero menu target, verify the registered menu item is visible, and trigger it through Host Actions.
smokeChecks: Host Action `menu.show` opens the live host menu for the requested target.
The registered menu item becomes visible in the live menu popup.
Host Action `menu.trigger` dispatches the live menu command and returns a local evidence target.
